title: Silver Plus Account: Late Interest Posting
content:
## Interest Posting Schedule

- Monthly interest on the Silver Plus Account posts on the first business day of the month.

## Late Postings (Internal)

- If interest posts more than 3 business days late because of a Rho-Bank processing delay, the customer may receive a goodwill credit of $15.00 for the inconvenience.
- Confirm the posting date in the account's transaction history.
- Apply the credit with apply_savings_account_credit_6831, credit_type 'goodwill_credit'. One goodwill credit per delayed posting.
